entry.name: speedlim
entry.digest: Limit the speed of message throughput
entry.description: Limit the throughput speed of incoming messages to a fixed time limit. The time can be specified in milliseconds or using a tempo-relative interval.

arguments.name: delta-time
arguments.description: Sets an initial minimum time between outputs. Time can be specified in any of theused in Max. If there is no argument, the minimum time is 0 milliseconds.

attributes.name: quantize
attributes.digest: Quantize to time boundary
attributes.description: Send output only on the specified time-boundary if appropriate. This is achieved by making internal adjustments to the times used for sending output. The quantization can be specified in the following: bars.beats.units, ticks or note values.

messages.name: anything
messages.digest: Pass the message after a time limit
messages.description: In left inlet: The message is passed out the outlet, provided that a certain minimum time has elapsed since the previous output. Otherwise, the message is held until that amount of time has passed (or until it is overwritten by another incoming message).

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Pass the message after a time limit
messages.description: Performs the same function as anmessage applied to the passing ofmessages.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Pass the message after a time limit
messages.description: In left inlet: Performs the same function as anmessage applied to the passing of integers.In right inlet: The number is stored as the minimum amount of time, in milliseconds, between successive outputs.

messages.name: list

messages.description: In left inlet: Performs the same function as anmessage applied to the passing of lists.In right inlet: A list may be used to specify time in one of the Max.
